title: Require an established actor for participant mandate grants
summary: The shared mandate profile now refuses every mode when a governing mandate names a participant but no acting agent was established, even for one participant. A path-only mandate does not make its participant an eligible CLI actor. This aligns CLI refusals with the selected edit guard without expanding authority. Owners may declare a workspace steward or workspace-scoped participant in authored source, validate, and rerun; --actor still accepts only eligible workspace participants or the steward. Participantless mandates and ungoverned operations retain their existing rules. Callers passing a plain authority or compiled mandate with a participant must establish its binding before judging its grants.
